precedence: FT-147 replaces FT-146 ambient and statePlacement behavior; geometry and persistent home assignment remain FT-146
scope: floor only; building keeps real counts and existing miniatures

identity.floorMarker: small dashed grey ring; agents retain solid state rings
identity.legend: Rombo gris: ambiente decorativo; no indica trabajo real

scheduler.clock: visible elapsed seconds in existing requestAnimationFrame; pause while hidden; cap resume delta at 0.1s
scheduler.determinism: stable project.id hash (FNV-1a unsigned UTF-8) modulo 60 gives initial phase; fixed catalog order; no Math.random
scheduler.busyRatio: non-idle real agents / real team size, using fidelity adapter; unknown counts busy; empty team disables ambient
scheduler.characterBudgetIncludes: visitors, cleaner, courier, maintenance, all meeting participants, and exiting actors
scheduler.admission: at window boundary, choose oldest overdue eligible episode, tie by catalog order; whole group must fit; reserve seats and route before entry; initial lastStart=0
scheduler.frequency: earliest next start = last start + basePeriodSeconds * current cadenceMultiplier; not a guaranteed appointment; holds never trigger catch-up spawns
scheduler.loadIncrease: stop admissions immediately; existing groups leave by return route after current dwell; budget is an admission limit during graceful drain, absolute hard cap stays 3
scheduler.reducedMotion: disable moving episodes; at most one static grey maintenance figure on reception handoff, only if unoccluded; no clock catch-up

catalog.appearance: stone-grey apron #CFD7DF, striped hem, muted teal gloves #648C88, compact cart following behind; no agent badge

phases.pose: small mop strokes on unoccupied floor

catalog.condition: clean only empty floor patches in corridors beside zones; never enter desks; skip occupied patch and continue; cart counts as obstacle, not character

catalog.appearance: sand coat #B9AF9E, charcoal trousers, grey diamond lapel; no agent badge

phases.pose: seated waiting, no phone or task bubble

catalog.condition: reserve reception sofa and meeting chair; postpone if unavailable; visits never use idle seats reserved for real agents

catalog.appearance: muted brown jacket #A58C72, grey cap, cardboard parcel; no bright error/working colors

phases.pose: place parcel on reception counter, then take it away

catalog.condition: handoff unoccupied; parcel is local decoration, never an attachment, task delivery, or notification

catalog.appearance: grey-beige striped vests #CFD7DF / #B9AF9E, neutral papers; all participants have hollow grey diamond

phases.pose: alternate slow head turn and paper gesture; no work indicators

catalog.condition: 2 people in mixed band, 3 in quiet band, disabled in busy band; atomic reservation; unused third path omitted; no real meeting without explicit SSE evidence

catalog.appearance: slate overalls #7B8993, grey tool bag, neutral cap; no badge, state bubble, or alert ring

phases.pose: open and close decorative printer tray

catalog.condition: service anchors free; skip occupied service dwell; printer never signals a real incident

movement.routeDuration: phase seconds are nominal minima; duration=max(seconds, path length / maxSpeed); dwell and yield add time; never accelerate to catch up
movement.turn: face next segment with 0.25s eased turn; no diagonal shortcuts across furniture
movement.yield: real agents reserve segment first; ambient waits at last clear node; same-priority ambient FIFO then stable id; groups walk single file with 0.6u spacing
movement.blockedExit: wait visibly at last safe point; no timeout teleport; cancel only before spawning
movement.earlyExit: finish current dwell then reverse recorded traversed segments to entry from current interpolated position; no jump to nominal return-path start
movement.groupReturn: each participant reverses its own fanOut path, then common entry path; never concatenate other participants' chair paths; unused third chair omitted
movement.occupancy: reserve seats atomically for complete episode; real agents always preempt ambient, who walks out without displacing agent
movement.screenOcclusion: project bubble and user-desk rectangles each camera frame; inflate by 16px; hide ambient mesh, icon, props and shadows only while intersecting protected region; logical route continues
movement.labels: preserve FT-146 48px real label separation; no ambient label competes with agent bubbles

adapter.newGeometry: bindings with kind are additions relative to FT-146 anchors; resolve in each selected layout; add reception sofa, plant, printer and service nodes without modifying agent desks
adapter.collisionGate: before enabling episode, sweep body + cart/props along every segment against actual Kenney bounds, glass, walls and reserved slots; turn space included; invalid path disables that episode and reports debug reason
adapter.agentGraph: future graph needs desk side-access, QA access, user waiting slots and recreation slots; these are specified in fidelidad.md and must not be confused with ambient paths
adapter.snapshot: S.projects, S.agents, S.tasks, S.questions only; /api/events can supply existing real activity detail, never decorative events
